newsitem.title: CHINA: China's stocks rebound on rate rumours.
newsitem.headline: China's stocks rebound on rate rumours.

text.p: China's A and B share indices closed up on Tuesday on a rebound encouraged by rumours that the central bank was planning to cut interest rates in the first quarter of this year, brokers said.
On Shanghai's B share market, the index rose 2.01 percent to 63.023 points, on volume of 14.8 million shares worth $7.2 million against $6.6 million on Monday.

Shanghai brokers said major institutions pushed the index above the key 63-point resistance level in the last few minutes in order to help the listing of the new B share, Shanghai Kaikai, on Wednesday.
Property developer Lujiazui remained the most active stock, ending up $0.026 or 3.7 percent at $0.866, on volume of 3.7 million shares.
In Shenzhen, the B share index rose sharply by 4.17 percent to close at 142.15 on turnover of HK$136 million compared with the previous session's HK$89 million.

All 43 Shenzhen-listed B shares gained on Tuesday, with Health Mineral Water rising HK$0.43 to end at its 10 percent limit-up of HK$4.70 on volume of 923,185 shares, making it the day's best B share performer.
There were rumours that China planned to ease its credit controls by lowering bank reserve requirements later this year, which boosted market sentiment, brokers in both Shanghai and Shenzhen said.

"The rumours fuelled strong institutional demand for financial industry issues in the A share market and pushed the A share index sharply higher, with the B share market following suit," a Shenzhen broker said.
Shanghai's A share index rose 2.49 percent to 936.570 points while Shenzhen's A share index was up a sharp 4.36 percent to 333.17, with turnover rising to 4.59 billion yuan from 3.78 billion.
On the Shanghai A share market, Anshan Trust was the star on the talk of possible cuts in interest rates, jumping to its 10 percent limit-up of 9.57 yuan.
Shenzhen's A share market leader Shenzhen Development Bank was the most actively traded stock on volume of 32.72 million shares and advanced 1.13 yuan to 17.02 yuan.
Shaanxi International Trust and Investment closed at its 10 percent limit-up of 9.65 yuan on heavy trade of 26.05 million shares.
